column1: In a large bowl, whisk the olive oil, balsamic glaze, tomato paste, honey, and lemon juice, then whisk in the garlic, thyme, oregano, and paprika.
Pat the chicken dry and season both sides well with salt and pepper.
Toss the chicken in the marinade. Let it sit while the oven heats, or refrigerate covered for a couple of hours for more flavor.
Heat the oven to 425°F (218°C) with a rack in the middle.
Arrange the chicken in a baking dish or ovenproof skillet and bake 25–30 minutes until it reaches 165°F (74°C).
